player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne Player {player_id} wɔ {num_rounds}-round Rock-Paper-Scissors agorɔ mu.
Wo botae ne sɛ woadi nkunim wɔ round bebree senea ɛbɛyɛ.
Wɔ round biara mu, kyerɛ w'adwene mu baako wɔ: '[rock]', '[paper]', anaa '[scissors]'.
Wo nso betumi afa '[r]', '[p]', anaa '[s]' sɛ shorthand.

message.round_draw: Ɔfã a etwa to: Nsaano nkyerɛwee
message.round_win: Ɔfã a etwa to: Player {winner} no adi nkonim!

outcome.p0_wins: Ɔpanyin 0 na odi nkonim wɔ mmirika no mu dodow!
outcome.p1_wins: Ɔpanyin a odi kan no na odii nkonim wɔ mmirika dodow mu!
